text.tspan: The DOM Event Path and Delegation
One click travels down to the deepest element, then back up. Listening high up is delegation.
Inside the one handler on the <ul>
That gap IS delegation: one listener on the parent
handles every child, including ones added later.
Pass true as the third argument to addEventListener
to run on the way DOWN instead.
